G_INVARIANTS.statement: Only the canonical publisher may describe an internal-v2 OTA as canonical.
An internal-v2 publication requires an exact android or ios platform marker.
An iOS publication cannot acquire Android provenance.
An Android publication cannot acquire iOS provenance.
A production OTA cannot claim internal-v2 provenance.
Every OTA plan binds source commit, source tree, runtime, channel, platform, environment, and app-owned activation.
Internal-v2 publication requires a clean worktree at exact protected main.
An iOS internal-v2 plan retains compiled native-call capability without granting it to Android.
A signed artifact is never rebuilt merely because submission or Apple processing is delayed.
EAS FINISHED is not authoritative Apple receipt or TestFlight availability.
Every alternate upload rereads the primary submission and Apple state immediately before mutation.
A fallback upload aborts when the primary submission or Apple state has advanced.
Artifact identity includes an exact cryptographic digest before any upload decision.
The same artifact cannot acquire a second active or completed submission intentionally.
A retry requires a changed or newly proved failure boundary.
Provider queue, local network, checksum corruption, Apple validation, Apple processing, and group availability are distinct states.
A resumable delivery receipt contains no credential, token, signed URL, device identifier, or private provider payload.
Apple authoritative state alone advances APPLE_RECEIVED_PROCESSING and APPLE_BUILD_VALID.
TestFlight internal availability is distinct from Apple build validity.
Installed exact build requires device readback and cannot be inferred from TestFlight availability.
Physical automation startup reconstructs Android, Appium, WDA, tunnel, and relay boundaries deterministically.
Physical startup never commits credentials, pairing records, signing material, or private device identifiers.
Android visibility, screenshot, and UI query have explicit independent results.
iPhone visibility, WDA readiness, forwarding, Appium session, screenshot, and UI query have explicit independent results.
Automation infrastructure failure is never classified as a Chi'llywood product defect.
A fresh session can stop only task-owned safe processes before canonical reconstruction.
Previously authorized tunnel reconstruction does not request repeated administrator credentials during ordinary sessions.
Protected-main admission remains strict for substantive product, security, native, database, and provider failures.
Protected main permits merge commits only while rolling truth depends on first-parent ancestry.
Ruleset bypass remains Integration 4707730 only after any bounded recovery.
Current-truth authority cannot transfer between PR, head, tree, or base identities.
No hardening command publishes a public release, enables production money, or reopens closed Chat qualification.
